evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

cases.name: Extend an existing REST surface
cases.query: Design endpoints for 'saved searches': create, list, run, delete. Here's our existing OpenAPI spec — match it.
files: OpenAPI spec with cursor pagination, snake_case, RFC7807-style errors
baseline_risks: Generic REST design that forks conventions (camelCase, offset pagination, ad-hoc errors); no idempotency for create/run
expected_behavior: Conventions matched to the provided spec with citations
Create and run have explicit idempotency semantics; run addresses long-running execution
must_not: Fork pagination or error conventions without acknowledgment

cases.name: Unknown consumers
cases.query: Design a public API for our internal tagging engine. We don't know yet who will consume it or from where.
baseline_risks: Designs a sprawling surface for imagined consumers, marking many fields required
expected_behavior: Flags unknown consumers as the central risk
Recommends a minimal surface with conservative forever-promises (few required fields, opaque IDs)
Evolution rules do the heavy lifting; open questions list what consumer discovery must answer
must_not: Present invented consumer patterns as known

cases.name: Batch operation partial failure
cases.query: Add a bulk-import endpoint accepting up to 10,000 contacts per request. Design the contract.
baseline_risks: All-or-nothing 200/500 with no per-item results, no idempotency, no async consideration
expected_behavior: Partial-failure semantics decided explicitly (per-item results or transactional, justified)
Sync-vs-async decision addressed for the 10k size; limits and error shape defined

cases.name: Innocent-looking breaking change
cases.query: Small change request: rename 'expires' to 'expires_at' in the token response, and make the previously optional 'scope' field required in create-token requests. Ship it in the next minor release — review the plan.
files: current API spec and a note that external consumers exist
baseline_risks: Approves it as cosmetic; both changes are breaking for existing consumers
expected_behavior: Classifies both changes as breaking with the consumer-impact mechanism explained
Proposes a compatible path (additive field + deprecation window; server-side default for scope)
States the deprecation signal and window
must_not: Bless shipping either change as non-breaking

cases.name: Internal helper signature
cases.query: Should this private helper take (userId, options) or an options object with userId inside? It has two internal callers.
baseline_risks: Skill could impose versioning/error-contract ceremony on an internal function signature
expected_behavior: Answers as ordinary code style/design judgment; no contract artifacts
must_not: Produce pagination/versioning/error-contract analysis for a private helper
